detail.controlsBody: Run a focused recovery action without leaving this screen.

detail.recoveryBody: Retry recovery or leave safe mode after resolving a fault.
detail.autostartBody: Installs the player’s own systemd user service so it starts with the graphical session and restarts after any exit. Setting up is safe while the player is running: Tilecast captures this AppImage’s display, data directory, and server address, writes and enables the service, and does not start a duplicate process. The current manual process keeps running until the next controlled restart, session restart, or reboot, when systemd takes ownership. A service file you wrote yourself is never overwritten. A graphical session that begins at boot (auto-login or a kiosk compositor) remains operating-system setup.
detail.removeAutostartBody: This screen will keep playing now, but will not return on its own after a reboot or a player update.
detail.displayBody: Player connectivity and display power are separate states. Controls appear only for capabilities reported by this player; provider commands have a bounded timeout and may report sent without a confirmed panel state.
detail.inputBody: Enter the CEC physical address reported by the display, for example 1.0.0.0.

detail.airplayDiagBody: Probe UxPlay, GStreamer, VA-API, audio, and local Avahi support without advertising a receiver.

detail.clearCacheBody: Tilecast will remove cached media that active or pending playback does not protect.

detail.disableBody: The player will remain paired and connected, but ordinary scheduled playback will stop.

detail.disabledBody: Enabling allows the paired player to reconnect.
detail.revokeBody: Permanently invalidates the device credential. The player must pair again.
detail.revokeConfirmBody: The player will disconnect immediately and cannot reconnect without a new pairing approval.

fireTv.title: Optional Fire TV Accessibility Control
fireTv.body: Fire OS does not expose Tilecast in its normal Accessibility menu. Commissioning can continue without this feature, or an administrator can enable Tilecast’s accessibility service manually through ADB.
fireTv.first: Enable ADB debugging on the Fire TV first. These commands use the player’s last reported address when available.
fireTv.copyFail: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the commands manually.
fireTv.last: Run both commands, reopen Tilecast Player, and choose Verify again. The enable command preserves other accessibility services.
